Based on the retrieved excerpts, your site safety dashboard activity is covered by **clause 9.1.1**.

This clause specifically addresses the determination of "what needs to be monitored and measured — including progress on... OH&S objectives — the methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation, the criteria and indicators, and when monitoring happens and results are evaluated" (Doc 1 — clause 9.1.1).

Your dashboard directly implements this requirement by:
- Defining **what** to monitor: near-miss reporting rates, safety-training completion, and lost-time injury rates
- Establishing **methods**: a dashboard with leading and lagging indicators
- Setting **criteria and indicators**: measurement against annual targets
- Determining **when**: ongoing tracking with evaluation against annual timelines

Additionally, **clause 6.2.2** is relevant as it requires planning "how the results — including monitoring indicators — will be evaluated" for each OH&S objective (Doc 2 — clause 6.2.2), which your dashboard supports by tracking progress toward your annual safety targets.
